description: $0.01 per call for one to five mints, not per mint. Use when you hold or watch two to five pump.fun mints; for one mint check_pumpfun_risk ($0.005) costs less, and check_coverage and watchlist_updates are free. Input: mints (1-5, each a mint or a pump.fun/gmgn/solscan/birdeye link), optional cursor. Each mint gets the compact check's item: findings with first-observed times, P(rug within 5 min), P(true graduation), concentration, flow, market and authorities. Every mint needs full live coverage and feed lag <= 5 s, or the batch is refused before payment. No flags observed is not a safety guarantee. Retrying the exact signed payment within 10 min replays the result, no new settlement.

cursor.description: Optional opaque watch cursor for these exact mints; no new watched events returns an unpaid result.

mints.description: One to five distinct pump.fun mints, each a mint or a pump.fun/gmgn/solscan/birdeye link. All must have full live coverage.

items.description: a mint or a pump.fun/gmgn/solscan/birdeye link
